author: M. Tremblay
comment: Customer reported their debit card was compromised after a phishing attempt. Card was replaced and the customer was advised to update their online banking credentials. Monitor for further unauthorized activity.

author: S. Patel
comment: Customer filed a complaint regarding the monthly account fee policy. Fee was waived for one cycle as a goodwill gesture and the customer was referred to the fee schedule. Follow up if the concern recurs.
